profile_text.body:
Anyword is an AI content company whose site describes a platform for go-to-market teams that care about performance and brand. It says the platform works with any AI model or application, adding A/B-tested data and brand context to every prompt, and that its generation engine is LLM-agnostic, so customer data is not used to train third-party models. The company describes its product as predictive performance AI copy for marketing optimization, with performance prediction scores that indicate which content assets will perform best before publication, plus a Content Intelligence feature that compares published content against an industry-specific A/B test data set. It also offers APIs for performance predictions and RAG capabilities, and says it can generate audience personas.

The site makes several quantitative claims. It states that Anyword makes AI content perform 76% better and that customers achieve a 30% lift in business outcomes, described elsewhere as a 30% increase in sales and business performance compared to baseline AI models. It says its performance prediction determines which of two content variations will perform better with 82% accuracy, against 52% for generic models such as GPT-5. It also cites 99.9% uptime with global availability and failover, and states adherence to SOC 2, ISO, GDPR, and HIPAA standards, with SSO, multi-factor authentication, and role-based permissions.

No litigation, regulatory filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are held for the company.
